picks.title: Anthropic acquires Stainless
picks.why_it_matters: A major AI lab acquiring developer tooling infrastructure signals consolidation in the AI stack and validates the API/SDK tooling category as a strategic investment area.

picks.title: South Korea's LetinAR is building optics behind AI glasses
picks.why_it_matters: As AI glasses emerge as a major platform shift, deep-tech component suppliers like LetinAR represent potential picks-and-shovels plays with multiple acquirer paths.

picks.title: Congress is scrambling to regulate prediction markets
picks.why_it_matters: Regulatory clarity—or crackdown—on prediction markets will reshape the opportunity set for fintech founders building in forecasting, information markets, and adjacent categories.
